title: ias15: a fast, adaptive, high-order integrator for gravitational dynamics, accurate to machine precision over a billion orbits
relevance: Demonstrates optimal Brouwer's law energy drift over 10^9 orbits, the benchmark for energy conservation in gravity integrators.

title: JANUS: a bit-wise reversible integrator for N-body dynamics
relevance: Achieves exact time reversal, providing the strongest possible validation of energy conservation.

title: Geometrical numerical integration methods for differential equations
relevance: Rigorous treatment of why symplectic integrators conserve energy better, including proofs of backward error analysis.

title: PENTACLE: Parallelized Particle-Particle Particle-Tree Code for Planet Formation
relevance: Discusses accuracy control via timestep/cutoff ratio, showing how energy drift drives parameter tuning in production codes.
